claims.text: Gleaniverse is Glean's primary customer community: a secure space to ask product questions, share feedback, and discover best practices.
Register for Gleaniverse with a work email so you receive the correct role and permissions.
The Gleaniverse home page offers three starting points: Start a Discussion, Join a Group, and Explore Academy.
Gleaniverse navigation includes Forum, Resources, Support Center, Events, Groups, Ask Query, and Academy.
Look before you post: search first, because the question may already be answered.
Glean Support runs a monthly live troubleshooting session on the second Thursday of each month, working through questions in small groups.
The Glean Product Team hosts monthly product updates on the fourth Thursday of each month.
Replays of previous Glean webinars and events are available on demand.
Glean Academy in Gleaniverse offers courses to master new topics.
Submit feature requests and product feedback on the Feedback and Ideas board in Gleaniverse.
The Admin Hub is a restricted space for customer administrators.
For bugs and errors in a Glean instance, file a support ticket. For questions, best practices, or feature requests, use the community.
Community answers let Support help multiple customers at once and can reduce inbound volume.
Keep sensitive information out: do not share confidential or personal data.
Keep it relevant: focus on Glean and the broader AI industry. No spam, self-promotion, bots, or unsolicited outreach.
Be kind and make it a safe space. Harassment, hate speech, or unwelcoming behavior is not tolerated.
Make it better and build together: share feedback and learnings, and help others when they need it.
Glean may remove content or restrict access for guideline violations. Report anything that does not feel right to the Glean team.

Priority levels are Low, Normal, High, and Urgent. Low covers non-critical issues such as general product inquiries and feature requests. Over-escalating priority can slow resolution for genuinely critical issues.
